title.narrative: PERFORMANCE-BASED PARTNERSHIP SCHEME FOCUSING ON QUALITY PROGRAMMING, UNDERSTANDING CHANGE AND RESULTS FOR POOR HOUSEHOLDS AND COMMUNITIES

description.narrative: The resilience to future emergencies in Afghanistan programme implemented by Concern Worldwide aims to build the resilience of displaced and host communities affected by conflict and natural disasters by providing for their immediate survival needs and supporting them to gain the infrastructure and skills to be more resilient to future emergencies. The objectives of the programme is to provide emergency provisions and shelter, cash, and winterization support; to work with communities and provincial authorities in Takhar and Badakhshan provinces to manage and improve their emergency response in an effective and timely manner; and to support the disaster response capacity of local NGO partners. . OVERALL COUNTRY PROG: Households can sustainably meet their basic needs and have improved coping strategies through strengthened livelihoods which place value on the natural environment . SPECIFIC OUTCOME: Concern is coordinating emergency responses with Takhar and Badakhshan Provincial Disaster Management Committee (PDMC). The responses included MPCA, emergency shelter, winterisation cash and non-food itemsand occured in very remote areas of Takhar and Badakhshan. Through joint assessments and coordinated responses, the capcity of the PDMC is being strenghtened to meeting people's emergency needs and to better prepare for future shocks.
